activities.name: Intramuros Walled City Tour
activities.description: Explore the Spanish-era fortifications of Manila's historic walled city on foot or by eco-bambike, visiting the 16th-century San Agustin Church, the haunting dungeons of Fort Santiago, and colonial plazas frozen in time.

activities.name: Mt. Pinatubo Crater Trek
activities.description: Ride 4x4 vehicles across a vast lunar-like lahar landscape then hike to the rim of a stunning turquoise volcanic crater lake formed after the 1991 eruption — one of the most dramatic natural wonders in Southeast Asia.

activities.name: Banaue & Batad Rice Terraces Trek
activities.description: Hike down into the UNESCO-listed amphitheater-like stone-walled rice terraces carved into the Cordillera mountains 2,000 years ago, descending to the spectacular Tappiya Falls hidden below.

activities.name: Sagada Cave Spelunking & Hanging Coffins
activities.description: Navigate the dramatic Lumiang-Sumaguing cave connection, squeezing through ancient limestone formations, then hike to Echo Valley to witness the centuries-old hanging coffins of the Igorot people wedged into cliff faces.

activities.name: Vigan Heritage Street Walk
activities.description: Step back into the Spanish colonial era walking the cobblestoned Calle Crisologo by horse-drawn kalesa carriage, lined with perfectly preserved 16th-century merchant houses — one of Asia's best-preserved heritage towns.

activities.name: Mt. Pulag Summit Expedition
activities.description: Undertake a midnight trek up Luzon's highest peak to watch dawn break above a rolling sea of clouds — one of the Philippines' most iconic and breathtaking high-altitude experiences.

activities.name: La Union Surf Session
activities.description: Catch waves at the beach breaks of San Juan, La Union — the surf capital of Luzon. Board rental and local instructor-led sessions available for all skill levels at Urbana and The Point.

activities.name: Taal Volcano Ridge & Island Trek
activities.description: View the iconic volcano-within-a-lake-within-a-volcano from the cool Tagaytay ridge, then take a boat tour to Volcano Island for an official guided trek around one of the world's smallest active volcanoes.

activities.name: Caramoan Peninsula Island Hopping
activities.description: Explore the dramatic limestone karst islands, hidden lagoons, and pristine sandbars of the Caramoan Peninsula — the remote Survivor filming location that remains blissfully uncrowded.

activities.name: Mt. Mayon ATV Adventure
activities.description: Ride off-road ATVs over volcanic boulders and black sand lava fields directly toward the base of the perfectly conical Mt. Mayon — the most active volcano in the Philippines.

activities.name: Binondo Chinatown Food Crawl
activities.description: Graze through the world's oldest Chinatown in Manila's Binondo district — tasting fresh Xiao Long Bao, crispy Lumpia Sariwa at New Po-Heng, and savory Pancit Malabon from century-old family stalls.

activities.name: Ilocos Empanada & Bagnet Feast
activities.description: Sink into the iconic street food of the Ilocos region — vivid orange deep-fried empanadas stuffed with green papaya and longganisa, alongside slabs of ultra-crispy Bagnet deep-fried pork belly.

activities.name: Bicol Express & Laing Dinner
activities.description: Taste the fiery flavors of Bicol — pork simmered in thick coconut milk with siling labuyo chilis (Bicol Express) and shredded taro leaves with crab meat (Laing). Finish with spicy chili ice cream at 1st Colonial Grill.

activities.name: Poblacion Makati Bar Crawl
activities.description: Manila's most dynamic nightlife neighborhood — hit speakeasies like The Back Room, creative cocktail bars like Agimat Foraging Bar with locally-foraged infusions, and rowdy multi-story bars across Poblacion's buzzing streets.

activities.name: La Union Beachside Nightlife
activities.description: San Juan's surf-town beach bar scene — catch live acoustic sets at Flotsam & Jetsam Hostel or climb to the rooftop at The Great Northwest for sunset cocktails with the surf crowd.

activities.name: White Beach & Paraw Sunset Sailing
activities.description: Stroll the powdery white sands of Station 1 and 2 then board a traditional outrigger paraw sailboat as it catches the wind for a breathtaking sunset cruise along Boracay's famous coastline.

activities.name: Chocolate Hills & Tarsier Safari
activities.description: View the surreal landscape of 1,200+ perfectly conical limestone mounds that turn chocolate-brown in dry season, then visit the Tarsier Sanctuary in Corella to encounter the world's smallest primate up close.

activities.name: Malapascua Thresher Shark Dive
activities.description: Scuba dive at Monad Shoal before sunrise to witness rare pelagic thresher sharks visiting cleaning stations — one of the only places on Earth with daily, predictable encounters with this elusive species.

activities.name: Kawasan Falls Canyoneering
activities.description: Plunge through a wild jungle canyon — cliff jumping, natural water slides, and swimming through emerald pools before arriving at the stunning multi-tiered turquoise Kawasan Falls. Pure adrenaline.

activities.name: Sardine Run & Turtle Snorkel
activities.description: Swim meters off Panagsama Beach into a swirling, shimmering wall of millions of resident sardines, then glide alongside massive, unbothered sea turtles in the same bay — all without a boat.

activities.name: El Nido Bacuit Bay Island Hopping
activities.description: Explore the Big Lagoon, Secret Lagoon, and razor-sharp limestone karst islands of El Nido's Bacuit Bay aboard a traditional outrigger — widely considered the most beautiful island scenery in the world.

activities.name: Puerto Princesa Underground River
activities.description: Navigate an 8.2-kilometer subterranean river system inside a UNESCO World Heritage cave — one of the New Seven Wonders of Nature — by paddle boat through immense cathedral-like chambers.

activities.name: Coron Shipwreck Dive & Kayangan Lake
activities.description: Dive or snorkel WWII Japanese shipwrecks now encrusted with coral, then swim through the hyper-clear, stratified freshwater and saltwater layers of the legendary Kayangan Lake.

activities.name: Siquijor Island Motorbike Loop
activities.description: Ride the coastal circuit of the mysterious 'Island of Fire' — hitting Cambugahay Falls, swimming under century-old balete tree roots, and cliff-jumping off the rocks at Salagdoong Beach.

activities.name: Apo Island Sea Turtle Snorkel
activities.description: Take a boat to the community-managed marine sanctuary of Apo Island and swim freely alongside massive, unhurried green sea turtles in one of the Philippines' most pristine and well-protected reefs.

activities.name: Gigantes Islands Scallop Feast & Hopping
activities.description: Island-hop to the remote Gigantes group — snorkeling Tangke Lagoon, walking the dramatic Cabugao Gamay sandbar, and binging on dozens of fresh baked scallops sold at just one peso each.

activities.name: Kalanggaman Island Sandbar
activities.description: Take an outrigger boat to Kalanggaman — a stark, remote island with a postcard-perfect long white sandbar extending into impossibly sapphire-blue seas, with almost no development in sight.

activities.name: Cebu Historical Heritage Trail
activities.description: Walk through the oldest city in the Philippines — visiting Magellan's Cross, the Basilica del Santo Niño, Fort San Pedro, and the heritage streets surrounding the Plaza Independencia.

activities.name: Danjugan Island Eco-Immersion
activities.description: Explore a strictly protected, solar-powered wildlife sanctuary island across five lagoons teeming with sea life, frigate birds, and mangroves — only accessible via certified eco-tour operators.

activities.name: San Juanico Strait Bridge Walk
activities.description: Cross and photograph the longest bridge in the Philippines, spanning the breathtaking swirling currents of the San Juanico Strait that separates the islands of Leyte and Samar.

activities.name: Cebu Lechon at Rico's or House of Lechon
activities.description: Feast on the Philippines' most celebrated dish — whole pig slow-roasted over coals and stuffed with lemongrass and garlic until the skin is glass-crisp. Cebu lechon is widely declared the best in the country.

activities.name: La Paz Batchoy at the Market
activities.description: Slurp a steaming bowl of Batchoy — Iloilo's legendary pork broth soup heaped with fresh egg noodles, liver, cracklings, and bone marrow at the historic La Paz Market where the dish was born.

activities.name: Loboc River Floating Restaurant Lunch
activities.description: Drift slowly down the jungle-canopied Loboc River on a floating restaurant boat while enjoying a Filipino buffet lunch with live cultural dance performances — a uniquely Boholano dining experience.

activities.name: El Nido Fresh Seafood Grill Night
activities.description: Pick your fresh catch from beachside grills in El Nido — choosing from grouper, squid, prawns, and sea grapes salad (lato). The brave can try Tamilok woodworm mollusk in Puerto Princesa.

activities.name: Boracay Beach Bar Crawl
activities.description: The ultimate island party strip — Epic Boracay for high-energy dancing in the sand, Exit Bar for a laid-back backpacker vibe, and reggae bars lining Station 2. Cheap drinks, warm ocean breezes, no cover.

activities.name: Sava Beach Bar & Republica Sunset Bar
activities.description: El Nido's top sunset bars in Corong-Corong — house music, stunning views over limestone karst silhouettes, an international crowd, and some of the most beautiful cocktail-hour scenery in the Philippines.

activities.name: Alona Beach Fire Dance Night
activities.description: Alona Beach on Panglao Island lights up with open-air acoustic bars, fire dancers, and Reggae Bar Panglao's classic island atmosphere — cheap rum and cokes, hammock bars, and an easy tropical vibe.

activities.name: Siargao Cloud 9 Surf Session
activities.description: Paddle out at the world-famous Cloud 9 reef break — a heavy, barreling right-hand wave that has hosted international surfing competitions for decades. Longboards available for beginners at Jacking Horse.

activities.name: Sohoton Cove National Park
activities.description: Navigate maze-like limestone cave channels by kayak, swim with completely stingless jellyfish in an enclosed lagoon, and cliff-dive out of the mouth of the thundering Hagukan Cave into open water.

activities.name: Enchanted River Exploration
activities.description: Gaze into the impossible deep-blue waters of a spring-fed river that emerges from an uncharted underwater cave system — the source has never been fully explored, adding to its legendary mystique.

activities.name: Tinuy-an Falls Bamboo Raft Ride
activities.description: Ride a bamboo raft right up to the misty spray curtain of the Philippines' widest waterfall — a three-tiered white water cascade so vast it's known as the Little Niagara of the Philippines.

activities.name: Mt. Apo Summit Climb
activities.description: Conquer the highest peak in the Philippines — a grueling 3-day climb through boulder fields, sulfuric vents, and mossy cloud forest to stand on the summit of the dormant stratovolcano.

activities.name: Camiguin Volcano Island Loop
activities.description: Circle the compact island of Camiguin — snorkeling the eerie underwater Sunken Cemetery, hiking the slopes of Mt. Hibok-Hibok, and relaxing on White Island sandbar with a cold coconut.

activities.name: Maria Cristina Falls Viewpoint
activities.description: Visit the spectacular twin-drop Maria Cristina Falls — a massive 320-foot cascade that serves as the primary hydroelectric power source for Mindanao. One of the Philippines' most powerful waterfalls.

activities.name: Lake Sebu T'boli Culture & 7-Falls Zipline
activities.description: Experience authentic T'boli indigenous culture through T'nalak weaving demonstrations and traditional longhouses, then ride one of the longest and most thrilling ziplines in Asia over a series of seven waterfalls.

activities.name: Aliwagwag Falls Tiered Rapids
activities.description: Explore the Philippines' tallest waterfall system — over 130 stair-like cascading tiers of crystal water descending through dense tropical forest in one of Mindanao's most remote and beautiful valleys.

activities.name: Dahilayan Adventure Park Zipline
activities.description: Fly down one of Asia's longest dual ziplines over a vast canopy of pine trees in the cool Bukidnon highlands — the clean mountain air and dramatic drop make this an unforgettable thrill ride.

activities.name: Davao Durian & Sinuglaw Feast
activities.description: Brave the king of fruits — fresh Davao durian at Magsaysay Park, the best in the Philippines — then feast on Sinuglaw, a brilliant fusion of grilled pork belly and raw tuna ceviche cured in vinegar and calamansi.

activities.name: Siargao Tuna Poke Bowl & Pan de Coco
activities.description: Start the morning with a classic sweet coconut-stuffed Pan de Coco from a wood-fired bakery in General Luna, then fuel up on fresh tuna poke bowls and smoothie bowls from Siargao's thriving health café scene.

activities.name: Lake Sebu Tilapia 50 Ways
activities.description: Indulge in Tilapia prepared every imaginable way — chicharron crispy-fried, kinilaw raw ceviche-style, sinigang sour broth, or baked whole with garlic — all harvested fresh directly from the scenic highland lakes.

activities.name: Siargao General Luna Nightly Bar Rotation
activities.description: Siargao operates a legendary rotating nightlife system where the crowd moves to a different designated venue each night of the week — underground DJ sets at Harana Surf on Saturdays, RumBar on Mondays, live acoustic jams in between.

activities.name: Matina Town Square Open-Air Live Music
activities.description: Davao's best open-air entertainment hub — catch exceptional live acoustic bands, local draft beers, and a relaxed crowd at Matina Town Square. Note: citywide alcohol sales end at 1 AM per local ordinance.
